title: Mecânico Diesel
description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios, desde 1955, a WLM atua no segmento automotivo e no agronegócio.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania , como caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, na prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais 20 pontos do país, atendendo a 06 estados diferentes, sendo Equipo - RJ, Itaipu - MG, Itaipu Norte - PA, Quinta Roda - SP e Supermac - AM e RR.

No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos e produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com grande preocupação pela conservação do meio ambiente, as atividades produtivas são executadas visando as melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas e cuidados com as águas e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética.

Com essa aquisição, a WLM amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

A localização estratégica das unidades permite uma atuação com abrangente cobertura geográfica, garantindo presteza, qualidade e agilidade no atendimento.

A sua holding está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e possui uma filial corporativa em Minas Gerais, na Cidade de Contagem.

Vem acelerar a sua carreira com o Grupo WLM!

Sua missão:

  • Executa reparos de baixa complexidade como manutenções preventivas, serviços de freios, serviços elétricos, eliminação de vazamentos e afins.
  • Auxilia na elaboração de planos de manutenção, nas manutenções de motores, sistemas e partes de veículos automotores.
  • Realiza serviços de lubrificação dos veículos utilizando bomba de lubrificação em eixos, quinta roda, sistema direcional, embuchamento e suspenção de acordo com a demanda especifica de cada veículo (preventiva e corretiva).
  • Faz orçamento de mão de obra e peças a serem aplicadas.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Médio completo
  • Informática Básica.
  • Noção/experiência em mecânica de autos ou pesados.
  • Imprescindivel disponibilidade de viagens!

Vantagens/Benefícios:

  • Ticket Alimentação - pensado para garantir praticidade no cuidado com a sua casa e família.
  • Assistência Médica - cuidando da sua saúde e de quem você ama.
  • Assistência Odontológica - cuidando do seu sorriso e de toda a sua família.
  • Seguro de Vida em Grupo e Assistência Funeral - proteção e segurança para você e sua família em momentos delicados.
  • Wellhub (Gympass) - incentivo à prática de atividades físicas e ao bem-estar.

Na Laços Saúde, a diversidade é o coração do nosso trabalho. O modelo Buurtzorg que adotamos é mais do que um método: é uma filosofia que prioriza o cuidado comunitário, respeitando a individualidade e as necessidades de cada pessoa. Se você é um Fisioterapeuta que acredita na transformação do cuidado à saúde, venha fazer parte da nossa equipe e ajude a moldar o futuro da saúde no Brasil. A Laços Saúde está pronta para receber você!

O Fisioterapeuta com ênfase no tratamento de idosos, desempenha um papel crucial na educação do paciente, praticando cuidados adequadas e promovendo orientações e acompanhamento para o envelhecimento saudável e digno.

A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com apromoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Planejar e programar as ordens de serviço de manutenção eletromecânica, considerando manutenção preventiva, preditiva e corretiva, conforme criticidade dos ativos.
  • Dimensionar horas de manutenção (HH), avaliando capacidade da equipe e reservando margem para atendimentos corretivos.
  • Verificar e assegurar a disponibilidade de recursos necessários à execução das ordens de serviço (mão de obra, materiais, ferramentas e terceiros).
  • Controlar prazos, escopos e execução das atividades, garantindo aderência ao planejamento técnico.
  • Monitorar indicadores de manutenção (MTBF, MTTR, backlog, cumprimento de planos e custos por OS).
  • Analisar falhas recorrentes e históricos de manutenção, propondo melhorias nos planos e processos.
  • Elaborar relatórios analíticos para suporte à tomada de decisão da liderança.
  • Atuar como interface entre manutenção, operação, engenharia e suprimentos.
  • Apoiar auditorias por meio da organização e controle da documentação técnica e histórico de manutenção.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior cursando ou completo em Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Vivência em planejamento e controle de manutenção.
  • Experiência com gestão de ordens de serviço, backlog e priorização de atividades.
  • Conhecimento de Excel avançado e ferramentas de planejamento (Project).

title: Party Chief
description:
UTEC, Acteon's Geo-services business line, harnesses data to optimise designs, save time and maximise your project's economic value by providing a holistic understanding of the marine environment. Our insights underpin customers' decision-making from design to asset life extension, ensuring every decision delivers.

UTEC is looking to add a Party Chief to the team. The Party Chief is UTEC's senior onboard representative and must ensure that all work is conducted in the best interests of UTEC and the Client. They are responsible for the safe, efficient and timely conduct of the project and for the assurance of quality. On site, they shall liaise closely with the Client Representative and Ship's Master and shall manage the day-to-day work program, subject only to direct instruction from or through the Project Manager and, in matters of vessel safety and discipline, the Ship's Master. It is the Party Chief's role to supervise those members of the survey team for whom they are responsible from the standpoint of technical and personal management. The Party Chief shall work closely with the vessel's Master in the event of an emergency or condition requiring shore assistance. The Party Chief shall oversee each use of the current UTEC field reference manuals and standard forms ensuring that, upon demobilization, a copy of any proposed revisions/corrections is saved to file and hard copy returned to the UTEC office within the project file.

The role is based offshore and will require travel to support UTEC operations, periods of onshore support may also be required working either remotely or from UTEC offices/workshops.

The successful candidates will be based in Brazil.

Duties

  • On appointment to the field project, the Party Chief shall manage mobilization in accordance with the Mobilization Procedure (SOP-001)
  • Immediately prior to first sailing, the Party Chief shall email the Project Manager all check lists duly signed and completed to date
  • Ensure that all survey parameters have been checked before the commencement of fieldwork
  • Ensure that all survey systems are in place for the contract and that all pre-sailing checks are carried out and documented
  • Ensure the Survey Event Log Book is comprehensively maintained by the Surveyors
  • Maintain a Rental Equipment list and return to office with Project Site file both hard & electronic
  • Initiate and close out NCR (non-conformance reports)
  • Submit requests for consumables/spares and ensure that the onboard Spares Master Register (on Excel) is maintained up to date
  • The Party Chief shall email signed checklists upon demobilization
  • Document any contractual variations and concessions
  • The Party Chief shall ensure that all data recorded is properly labelled, stored and logged and can be accounted for at all times especially when being prepared for transit. Depending on the nature of the project, much of this work will be performed by others, including the QC Geophysicist, but the Party Chief must ensure there are no 'gaps' in the system as (s)he bears overall responsibility.
  • On completion of mobilization alongside and of all harbor checks and calibrations, the Party Chief shall compile his/her checklist with those of the Senior Surveyor, the QC Geophysicist and the Engineer-in-Charge and after signature, shall send all checklists to the UTEC Operations Manager. Similarly, after signature upon completion of demobilization, these documents shall be sent to the UTEC Operations Manager
  • The Party Chief shall always be alert to the impact the deployment of survey sensors might have upon the vessel's ability to maneuver. Similarly, they shall be aware of the vessel's working location with particular regard to the proximity of structures and other vessels
  • Complete Final Survey Report as per UTEC approved format
  • Undertake field personnel assessments fairly, reflecting individual strength and weaknesses and recommending training as appropriate and submit to the Operations Manager ashore upon the departure of any crew member or upon the occasion of his/her being relieved
  • Fully brief all members of survey crew and key members of the ship's crew. Party Chief shall ensure that a Briefing Meeting is conducted, and a list maintained and signed by all attendees and retained in the project file (FRF-013)
  • Preparation and presentation of safety meetings at project start-up and ongoing toolbox meetings with marine and survey watch operators before deploying equipment or other potentially hazardous operations. Special emphasis is to be given to assist the Master and Safety Officer in promoting safe working practices

Required

  • Bilingual in Portuguese and English, strongly preferred
  • Education in Geomatics, Surveying Science
  • Relevant industry experience or military/academic experience in survey related discipline, including relevant management experience
  • Satisfactory completion of competence criteria for Senior Surveyor, Senior Survey Engineer, Senior Geophysicist or Senior Data Processor
  • Nominally 48 months' experience, including 400 operational days offshore as Senior Surveyor, Senior Survey Engineer, Senior Geophysicist or Senior Data Processor

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer - Debt Resolution
description:
Overview

Senior Staff Software Engineer - Debt Resolution

About Nubank Nu is the world’s largest digital banking platform outside of Asia, serving over 123 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. The company has been leading an industry transformation by leveraging data and proprietary technology to develop innovative products and services. Guided by its mission to fight complexity and empower people, Nu caters to customers’ complete financial journey, promoting financial access and advancement with responsible lending and transparency. The company is powered by an efficient and scalable business model that combines low cost to serve with growing returns. Nu’s impact has been recognized in multiple awards, including Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Banks. The Company is preparing for its next growth cycle where it will accelerate its internationalization process outside Latin America, and will also enter new verticals beyond financial services in its core markets taking advantage of the significant customer penetration.

About the role
We are hiring a Senior Staff Software Engineer to help lead the architectural direction of Nubank’s Global Debt Resolution platform, operating horizontally across all business areas. You will align the debt resolution stack to a cohesive long-term technical vision spanning Lending, Credit Card, and Credit Platform (Core Banking), ensuring we build globally scalable, compliant, and reusable solutions. This is a high‑influence IC leadership role where you will shape both the platform and the teams that build on top of it. You will identify the right long‑term patterns for collections, renegotiations, and payments, and push them consistently across all business areas and credit domains. By sitting at the intersection of Lending, Credit Card, and Credit Platform, you will ensure every new initiative builds toward a unified, multi‑market debt resolution platform.

Mission
Design and operationalize a horizontal technical strategy for Global Debt Resolution so that:

  • Legacy vs. Future is Deliberate: The boundaries between legacy, stable, and future systems are explicit, with clear migration plans and guardrails that reduce long‑term complexity and risk.
  • Cross‑BU Leverage is Maximized: High‑leverage capabilities (e.g., renegotiation, late‑state flows, payment allocation, credit core integrations) are built once and reused across Debt Resolution, Lending, Credit Card, and Core Banking, instead of re‑implemented in silos.
  • Business & Tech are Seamlessly Aligned: You act as a direct technical partner to business area leads and GMs, turning ambiguous credit/debt constraints into clear platform strategies and delivery roadmaps.

Responsibilities

  • Lead Architectural Direction for Global Debt Resolution: Define and evolve the long‑term architecture for the Debt Resolution platform.
  • Drive Cross‑Unit Collaboration & Alignment: Ensure architectural alignment and smart reuse across Lending, Credit Card, and Credit Platform (Core Banking), avoiding duplicated flows and inconsistent debt behaviors.
  • Design for Multi‑Market Scalability: Architect and evolve foundational systems to support multi‑geo rollouts, minimizing per‑country forks and enabling configuration‑driven behavior instead of code‑driven divergence.
  • Mentor Senior Engineers & Managers: Act as a technical mentor and challenger ICs and engineering managers in the BU, raising the bar on architectural depth, system thinking, and cross‑domain collaboration.
  • Balance Five‑Year Vision with Near‑Term Delivery: Combine long‑term architectural thinking with hands‑on support for current roadmaps in all business areas, ensuring that short‑term delivery steps move us closer to the desired target architecture.

Key Business & Engineering Metrics You Will Influence

  • Recovery Efficiency & Economics
  • Improved collections and renegotiation efficiency through better tooling and shared capabilities.
  • Platform Reuse & Adoption
  • Increased reuse of shared Debt Resolution components across products and geos.
  • Higher adoption rate of common patterns and building blocks versus bespoke solutions.
  • Engineering Stability & Correctness
  • Fewer incidents and production issues related to debt resolution, late‑state flows, or payment allocation.
  • Reduced regression and rework when launching new markets or features.
  • Faster launch of new markets and debt strategies on top of shared platforms.
  • Clear progress on deprecating legacy systems and moving flows into the target architecture.
  • Stakeholder Alignment & Satisfaction
  • Stronger perception of engineering as a strategic partner by GMs and business leaders.
  • Improved clarity of ownership and roadmaps across teams touching Debt Resolution.

Challenges and Opportunities (What You’ll Own)

  • Unifying Architectures: You will tackle the challenge of multiple, partially overlapping debt resolution stacks by identifying common patterns and driving convergence toward a single, extensible platform.
  • Making the Best Solution the Default Solution: You will ensure that the best ideas from any one team become the default standard for all, through clear patterns, documentation, and hands‑on collaboration.
  • Operating with High Agency: You will have the mandate to push for global efficiency and correctness, while working through influence—bringing along Staff+ engineers, EMs, and PMs across multiple BUs.
  • Balancing Risk, Compliance, and Speed: You will continually reconcile regulatory constraints, credit risk needs, and product velocity, making trade‑offs explicit and sustainable in the architecture.

What You’ll Navigate

  • Complexity of Scale & Legacy: Balancing immediate needs of specific product areas with the long‑term goal of a unified, multi‑market Debt Resolution platform, including leading teams through multi‑year migrations.
  • Constant Context & Communication Switching: Moving fluidly between deep technical design reviews and RFCs with engineers, and high‑level strategy discussions with GMs, Product Directors, Risk, and Operations.
  • Cross‑Geo & Cross‑BU Collaboration: Working with teams across geographies, and across multiple business units, requiring strong remote collaboration, clarity in documentation, and cultural adaptability.

If you feel interested in these challenges and want to work on a highly engaged and talented team transforming how Debt works in Brazil and beyond, this is the place for you!

Overview

Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) eSupermac(AM e RR).

No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladasFartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a EkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

title: Head of Commercial Partnerships
description:
Head of Commercial Partnerships

Department: Commercial & Marketing

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (”FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup™ (”FWWC”).

The Head of Commercial Partnerships has responsibility, under the leadership of FIFA’s Director Commercial Partnerships and the operational guidance of the Brazil Entity Chief Operations Officers, for the successful implementation and coordination of the commercial revenue programs for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

This cross-functional position plays a critical role in planning, managing and implementing Host Country commercial revenues activities related to sponsorship sales, partnership management & partner rights delivery and commercial operations.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • In close cooperation with FIFA’s Commercial Partnerships department, manage the day-to-day implementation plans in relation to the Tournament’s commercial partnerships programs, as well as manage relevant local sales agencies and service providers.
  • Working with Relevant Department Heads from FIFA, lead the Host Country commercial partnerships staff across sponsorship sales, partnership management and partner rights delivery.
  • Work with FIFA Commercial Partnerships Sub-Division and Host Country to shape integrated plans and strategies, including relevant sales and operational plans.
  • Working closely with the FIFA Partnership Sales team, ensure the effective delivery of the Tournament’s sponsorship sales with a focus on regional sponsorships in host country.
  • Identify and develop strong relationships with potential key sponsors and agencies in the host country and wider region, proactively lead on contract negotiations, and contribute to maintaining strong and effective relationships with sponsors.
  • Manage the regional sponsorship sales process in accordance with the defined timetable and priorities and negotiate agreements across relevant markets.
  • In close alignment with FIFA Partnership Management team, contribute to building strong and successful relationships with FIFA partners.
  • Working closely with FIFA Partner Rights Delivery team in Zurich and with the support of a local team, deliver all commercial operations as per the rights granted to Commercial Partners for the competition and competition-related events and sites.
  • In close collaboration with the FIFA Partner Rights Delivery team in Zurich and Brazil, ensure successful implementation of the public Food & Beverage (F&B) concessions programme across all stadiums.
  • Manage and support a talented team of individuals, located at Brazil HQ across all commercial partnerships and licensing projects.

YOUR PROFILE

  • 10+ years of international commercial experience in sport
  • Proven experience within global sports / Rights Holder environment
  • Proven track record managing major commercial programs across sponsorship sales, partnership management and commercial operations
  • Proven and successful track record in opening, negotiating and closing significant multi-year, multi-million sponsorship deals
  • Knowledge of commercial operations in major event settings and/or the sports industry
  • Experienced negotiator and ability to manage complex and lengthy processes
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build and maintain effective working relationships across multiple teams and at varying levels
  • Experience and knowledge of local markets and culture
  • Ability to work in a matrixed environment
  • Ability to hire, develop, coach, appraise and retain qualified employees
  • Experience of managing multi-disciplined teams across a variety of business areas
  • Capacity to make key decisions for the business through critical problem-solving skills and an ability to use sound judgement
  • Creative and strategic thinker from a diverse background
  • Proficient in preparing and managing budgets
  • Proven organisational skills with excellent attention to detail, particularly under pressure
  • Solid operational and strategic marketing knowledge/experience
  • Operational knowledge and experience in major international events, preferably sports events
  • Passion for sport

Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

A Aegea criou em 2010, é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.   • Pós-Graduação completa em uma ou mais das áreas citadas a seguir: Audiologia, Linguagem, Motricidade Orofacial, Saúde Coletiva, Disfagia, Fonoaudiologia Neurofuncional, Gerontologia ou Residência Multiprofissional em Saúde
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe
  • Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Fonoaudiólogo.

Local de Trabalho: Jacarepaguá/RJ

Carga Horária: 30H (diurno e noturno) e 40H (diarista)

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos , bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

title: Intern, Risk Engineer
description:
Job Description

ABS Interns are integrated into ABS business operations and will experience various aspects of engineering review, technical problem solving, and/or research and development. Interns will work with a designated advisor to learn and develop skills relating to ABS’s core business functions while also assisting ABS with key deliverables. It is expected that interns will be assigned multiple projects for their respective departments throughout the course of their internship. Interns will work at the local ABS Consulting Office.

What You Will Do

  • The primary function of an intern is to develop skills and knowledge of ABS core business functions including but not limited to:
  • Engineering Plan Review.
  • Technical Plan Review.
  • Research and Product Development.
  • Operational Safety and Evaluation.
  • Data Science and Digital Services
  • Interns may provide engineering support in the form of design review and analysis assignments typically involving a major project or several smaller, less complex projects. Projects will vary in complexity and difficulty.
  • Under the supervision of an experienced engineer or engineering manager, interns may assist with a detailed engineering review of plans as assigned for compliance with applicable Rules, Regulations, and contract commitments.
  • Communicate the status of the current workload to all appropriate members of the team to ensure that the needs of the clients will be met.
  • May propose technical advice to field operations and other technical offices.
  • May propose new approaches to problems encountered and make recommendations for changes in methods, procedures, or designs.
  • May assist in the development of business performance metrics including the development and implementation of an ongoing business performance monitoring program, and the periodic analysis of operating results to determine causes, trends, etc.
  • May assist with the writing and presentation of technical papers and reports concerning areas of expertise and work performed.
  • May assist with Rule development projects as assigned.
  • Interns may collaborate with the digital team and with other departments such as services, class, project management, commercial operations, etc.
  • Intern may assist with data collection efforts for data quality improvement, in both existing and new data streams to support overall business goals.

What You Will Need

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in progress in Chemical Engineering (other related Engineering degrees – e.g., Mechanical, Production, Safety, Process – may be considered).
  • Currently enrolled from the 6th semester (or equivalent) onwards.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Strong interest in risk analysis, process safety and process engineering, especially in sectors such as marine/offshore, oil & gas and mining.
  • Availability to work 30 hours per week (e.g., 6 hours per day, Monday to Friday), during business hours.
  • Intermediate knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) – especially Excel for data treatment and KPI/risk indicator analysis.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English (and Portuguese).
  • Organization, attention to detail and interest in quality, risk and safety from a systems and process perspective.
  • Analytical mindset and genuine interest in working with data, engineering information and risk scenarios.
  • Proactivity and curiosity to understand client processes, technologies and risk scenarios in marine/offshore, oil & gas, mining and other industrial sectors.
  • Attention to detail and rigor in technical documentation, records and analyses.
  • Teamwork and collaboration, with ability to interact with multidisciplinary technical teams (engineering, operations, safety, quality, etc.).
  • Good organizational skills to manage multiple analytical tasks and deadlines.
  • Ethical behavior, focus on safety and alignment with ABS values of integrity and responsibility.
  • Academic or extracurricular experience related to process safety, risk assessment, reliability, process simulation or industrial operations.
  • Basic understanding of risk analysis methods (e.g., HAZID, HAZOP, Bow-tie, LOPA, FMEA) and/or management systems (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001) – even if only from university courses.
  • Familiarity with process flowcharts, PFDs, P&IDs and basic process engineering concepts (mass/energy balance, unit operations, etc.).
  • Experience with spreadsheets and basic data analysis (advanced Excel, simple dashboards, basic BI tools) is a plus.

Reporting Relationships

You’ll work alongside engineer colleagues reporting into a Senior Manager.

Important: This internship does not involve laboratory activities. It is a position focused on theoretical and analytical work, risk and process evaluation, data analysis and technical documentation.

The Internship Program is housed in an HR Cost Center. This position does not have any direct reports.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. We’re at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

O Hospital Cardoso Fontes, é direcionado ao atendimento de média e alta complexidade. É uma das principais referências hospitalares da Zona Oeste do Rio de Janeiro. A unidade é reconhecida por sua atuação na área de fisioterapia oncológica, ginecologia, nefrologia (sistema urinário) e tratamentos em crianças com insuficiência renal, pneumologia e urologia.

Garantir o cumprimento de normas, rotinas, regulamentações da Instituição, e das atividades planejadas para assistência, participando, analisando e avaliando os processos de enfermagem e as interfaces com a equipe para promover uma assistência segura e de qualidade.

Ensino Superior Completo em Enfermagem.

Especialização completa em Urgência, Emergência ou Terapia Intensiva.

Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe.

Local: Jacarepaguá/RJ

Escala: 12x60 - 30h semanais

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, PAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

title: Engineering Manager, MAAS
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager as we expand the MAAS team. Our mission with MAAS ("Metal as a Service") is to provide the best solution for building and running private bare-metal infrastructure, putting a cloud-style on-demand API in front of physical server provisioning, network configuration, and storage. We\'re hiring engineering managers with experience in high-quality software development and high-performance team leadership who also have deep familiarity with Linux on physical servers, Linux storage and data center networking capabilities.

The Canonical MAAS team is responsible for delivering our Metal As A Service (MAAS) hyperscale provisioning technology. Ubuntu strives to be the most scalable, cloud ready server distribution and MAAS is our platform to get Ubuntu on bare metal servers. MAAS is a rapidly evolving software stack written in Python and Go. Its components span the entire software stack: from low-level hardware detection and provisioning, to the upper level management web interface, API, and CLI. Our most effective engineers are fluent in all these layers, and able to anticipate the consequences of design and engineering choices elsewhere in a complex distributed system.

Canonical is seeking passionate technical leaders who are eager to drive innovation in one of Canonical’s flagship data center products. You will play a key role in reshaping the future of data center technology through open source management platforms. MAAS aims to revolutionize data center management at scale starting from day zero deployment to long term data center expansion and maintenance.

Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop engineers, positively influence team and company culture, facilitate technical delivery, and guide strategy and execution. In addition to these responsibilities, you will be expected to collaborate across engineering. The MAAS team regularly interfaces with teams responsible for cloud-init, LXD, and our public cloud offerings.

The successful candidate will have technical leadership attributes and can demonstrate the ability to solve challenging distributed systems problems.

Location : This is a work-from-anywhere position available in EMEA or the Americas.

The role entails

  • Leading a distributed team of engineers in your time zone (we organise engineering teams by Americas, EMEA etc)
  • Talent development through coaching, mentoring, feedback and career planning
  • Setting and managing expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Being an advocate of, and advancing, modern software development practices
  • Participating in the engineering process through code and architectural review
  • Engaging with broader teams at Canonical, the open source community and partners
  • Travelling to internal and external global events for 4 to 6 weeks per year

What we are looking for in you

  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) and a background in Computer Science
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Experience with Linux system administration (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Familiarity with modern Linux cloud computing technologies, including networking, storage, containers and K8S
  • Technical aptitude for understanding complex distributed systems
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with agile software development methodologies
  • Ability to mentor, develop, and support team members
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long

Nice-to-have skills

  • Typescript using modern web frameworks such as React, Angular, Svelte or Vue
  • Data Center infrastructure management and design

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we\'ve been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

Como Gerente de Engenharia, você é responsável pelo gerenciamento eficaz de todas as operações de engenharia e manutenção dentro do hotel, incluindo conservação de energia. Você também é responsável pelo desenvolvimento da Equipe de Engenharia e fica a par dos regulamentos e procedimentos de conformidade no campo da Engenharia, conforme exigido pelos padrões do hotel. Especificamente, um Gerente de Engenharia executará as seguintes tarefas com os mais altos padrões:

  • Liderar a equipe de engenharia nas operações diárias de engenharia e manutenção do hotel, incluindo padrões de serviço, programações de equipamentos e cronogramas de trabalho.
  • Comunique-se com o serviço de limpeza para coordenar e priorizar atividades de manutenção para quartos de hóspedes e áreas públicas
  • Desenvolver sistemas e procedimentos para garantir a saúde e a segurança dos hóspedes e membros da equipe, bem como as condições adequadas para plantas, maquinaria e propriedade.
  • Comunicar-se com agências do governo para garantir o cumprimento integral dos regulamentos estatutários
  • Preparar orçamentos de capital e reparos e manutenção para engenharia
  • Realize verificações diárias ao redor do hotel
  • Conduzir os procedimentos de liberação de emergência, conforme necessário
  • Diagnosticar, manter e reparar equipamentos mecânicos dentro do hotel
  • Garantir que bons relacionamentos sejam construídos com clientes internos e externos
  • Manutenção de todos os equipamentos e instalações do hotel para garantir que estejam em condições seguras e agir quando surgem situações inseguras.
  • Desenvolver, implementar e dirigir todos os programas de emergência
  • Desenvolver, implementar e gerenciar programas de conservação de energia para a propriedade para minimizar as despesas
  • Coordenar a licitação de renovação, definir o custo e o escopo do projeto e supervisionar o empreiteiro geral e os subcontratados para garantir que o trabalho de qualidade seja realizado de forma econômica
  • Realizar projetos especiais e outras responsabilidades atribuídas
  • Identificar e introduzir sistemas e equipamentos ecologicamente corretos
  • Monitorar os principais indicadores de desempenho para o departamento de engenharia e tomar medidas corretivas, conforme necessário, para melhorar o inventário de equipamentos, a auditoria de qualidade, a produtividade e outros objetivos
  • Gerenciar todas as atividades relacionadas a membros da equipe, incluindo recrutamento, gerenciamento de desempenho, treinamento, planejamento de carreira, assuntos disciplinares e motivação da equipe.

O que estamos procurando?

Conhecimentos avançados de gestão / engenharia de edifícios

  • Exposição ao orçamento e contabilidade básica

  • Fortes habilidades de liderança e experiência anterior no gerenciamento de uma equipe
  • Excelentes padrões de higiene
  • Flexibilidade para responder a uma variedade de situações de trabalho diferentes
  • Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão
  • Capacidade de trabalhar por conta própria
  • Experiência anterior de gerenciamento de instalações
  • Proficiente, em um nível avançado, com computadores e programas de computador relevantes

title: Engenheiro (a) de Automação e Elétrica
description:
Somos a Brava Energia, a Companhia independente de óleo e gás mais diversificada do Brasil. Temos operações em terra e mar, do upstream ao downstream, com mais de mil colaboradores em nossa força de trabalho. Oferecemos amplas oportunidades para o desenvolvimento da sua carreira, em um ambiente dinâmico, focado em resultados e alta performance. Estamos constantemente aplicando a experiência do nosso time para maximizar nossa produção, transformando O&G em valor para o Brasil.

Missão do cargo

Atuar no suporte técnico especializado aos sistemas de automação, controle e elétrica das instalações de produção de óleo e gás offshore, contribuindo para a confiabilidade operacional, segurança, disponibilidade e eficiência dos ativos. O profissional deverá apoiar a introdução, acompanhamento e monitoramento de indicadores de desempenho (KPIs), colaborar na melhoria contínua dos sistemas de automação e elétrica, assegurar a conformidade com normas técnicas e regulatórias — com destaque para a NR-10 — e suportar a tomada de decisão técnica por meio de análises orientadas a dados.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Apoiar tecnicamente os sistemas de automação e controle de processos utilizados na produção de óleo e gás offshore, incluindo sistemas de controle distribuído (DCS), CLPs, sistemas de segurança (ESD/PSD), instrumentação e sistemas supervisórios.
  • Acompanhar e analisar o desempenho dos sistemas de automação, identificando desvios operacionais, falhas recorrentes e oportunidades de melhoria na confiabilidade e disponibilidade dos sistemas de produção.
  • Introduzir, acompanhar e monitorar KPIs técnicos relacionados aos sistemas de automação e elétrica, tais como disponibilidade de sistemas críticos, falhas de controle, tempo de atendimento e aderência a planos de manutenção. Disponibilidade de sistemas de controle de automação críticos, número de falhas de automação e instrumentação, tempo de atendimento (MTTR – quando aplicável), taxa de falha recorrentes em sistemas de controle.
  • Apoiar análises de falhas e eventos operacionais em sistemas de automação e elétrica, participando de análises técnicas estruturadas e propondo ações corretivas e preventivas sob orientação de engenheiros mais experientes.
  • Atuar no suporte aos sistemas elétricos críticos, incluindo geração de energia, distribuição elétrica, painéis, motores, inversores, UPS, sistemas de aterramento e proteção, assegurando confiabilidade e continuidade operacional.
  • Assegurar conformidade técnica e regulatória, apoiando o cumprimento das normas aplicáveis, com ênfase na NR-10, NR-12 e demais normas técnicas elétricas e de automação aplicáveis ao ambiente offshore.
  • Auxiliar na gestão e melhoria da qualidade dos dados técnicos e de manutenção dos sistemas de automação e elétrica no CMMS (IBM Maximo), garantindo registros completos, padronizados e confiáveis.
  • Participar da elaboração, revisão e aplicação de procedimentos técnicos, instruções de trabalho e padrões corporativos relacionados à automação, elétrica, instrumentação e segurança elétrica.
  • Acompanhar testes, comissionamentos, intervenções e melhorias técnicas em sistemas de automação e elétrica, garantindo aderência aos projetos, normas técnicas e requisitos de segurança.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos sistemas e do conhecimento técnico da equipe, absorvendo e disseminando boas práticas de automação, elétrica, segurança funcional e qualidade de dados técnicos.

Requisitos e qualificações

Formação: Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia de Automação, Engenharia de Controle e Automação ou áreas correlatas.

Conhecimentos | Habilidades | Experiência

  • Experiência e vivência prática em automação, elétrica industrial, manutenção ou operação de sistemas industriais, com histórico comprovado.
  • Conhecimentos fundamentais em automação industrial, sistemas de controle de processos, instrumentação e sistemas elétricos industriais.
  • Conhecimento das normas técnicas e de segurança aplicáveis, com ênfase na NR-10, NR-12, IEC, IEEE e normas brasileiras pertinentes.
  • Conhecimento de sistemas de controle (DCS, CLP), sistemas supervisórios e instrumentação de processo.

description:
Overview

The Senior Estimator uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the estimating discipline within McDermott. They will act as a resource for colleagues with less experience and share their conceptual and practical expertise related to the estimating discipline. The Senior Estimator solves complex problems and uses their discipline-specific knowledge to improve their products or services. The Senior Estimator impacts a range of customer, operational, project, or service activities with the estimating team and other related teams and ensures that they are working within the appropriate guidelines and policies.

Responsibilities

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering is a plus
  • 5+ years of experience in a large Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) company (preferably in estimating, project controls, and data analytics)

About Us

Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably.

For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries.

About Wati

Started as a WhatsApp team inbox in 2020, Wati has evolved into a full revenue orchestration system that goes beyond a single platform. We empower businesses that sell, support, and grow through conversations by observing customer intent in real-time, deciding the next best revenue action, and executing it seamlessly across marketing, sales, and support—all within WhatsApp and connected messaging channels.

Our Platform & AI Capabilities

Wati is designed for scalability and intelligence. Our AI-native platform simplifies complex customer communication operations through a unified inbox, a robust multi-channel messaging infrastructure, and no-code automation. At the heart of our solution is Astra, our intelligent AI layer, which helps you create AI Agents for all customer interactions and all your messaging platforms. By integrating AI agents into the ecosystem, we enable businesses of all sizes to deliver measurable ROI and build deeper customer relationships.

Our Backing & Partnerships

Trusted by over 16,000 customers across 190+ countries, Wati is proudly backed by world‑class investors including Tiger Global, Sequoia Capital, DST Global, and Shopify. As a Premium‑tier Partner of Meta and Google, we maintain the highest standards of platform excellence and integration.

About the Role

We are looking for an Agentic Engineer to join our Customer Advisory Board (CAB) team in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The CAB team is dedicated to building tailored, custom solutions for our most valuable clients in the LATAM region. In this role, you will lead Wati’s regional custom engineering efforts, working closely with clients, product managers, and regional teams to translate complex, customized business requirements into scalable engineering solutions. You will combine strong engineering execution with a deep understanding of the local market, building API integrations, automating workflows, and shipping bespoke features that directly solve our clients' unique challenges in Brazil and across Latin America. This role requires someone who is highly adaptable, execution‑oriented, and comfortable operating at the intersection of core engineering and client‑facing customized delivery.

What You Will Do

  • Lead engineering initiatives to design, build, and deploy custom features and workflows tailored to the specific needs of Wati's key clients in the LATAM market
  • Partner directly with the CAB team and regional stakeholders to deeply understand bespoke client requirements and translate them into robust technical architectures
  • Develop seamless integrations between Wati's platform and local LATAM third‑party systems, CRMs, ERPs, and payment gateways commonly used by our Brazilian and regional clients
  • Ensure the high reliability, security, and scalability of custom‑built solutions, maintaining Wati's standard of excellence even in highly specialized enterprise environments
  • Iterate rapidly on custom deployments, troubleshooting client‑specific technical issues and providing engineering support for critical LATAM accounts
  • Continuously improve internal tooling and frameworks to accelerate the delivery speed of custom client solutions
  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering, preferably in B2B SaaS, enterprise software, or custom solutions development
  • Proven experience building scalable API integrations and working with complex system architectures to meet specific enterprise client needs

description:
Multi Site Environmental Manager, Environmental Assurance and Protection (EAP)

Brazil's Environmental Assurance and Protection (EAP) team is seeking a Multi Site Environmental Manager (MSEM) to support our Amazon Operations. This role supports multiple sites. The MSEM will develop standards and policies to support regulatory compliance as well as partner with operations leadership teams for execution of these standards and policies, to ensure compliance with all applicable county/locations specific Federal, State and local laws and regulations. The MSEM travels greater than 50% of the time.

Key job responsibilities

  • Manage and execute multi site responsibilities to comply with stormwater, waste, wastewater and other environmental related laws, regulations and permits. This includes required Federal, State and local reporting.
  • Manage and execute business conformance with Amazon EAP Management Systems Policies. Develop Amazon Geo-Specific Operational Environmental Procedures by integrating with engineering, construction and operations.
  • Lead regulatory agency interactions, permit evaluation and processing, and new process and technology introduction.
  • Primary point of contact for environmental regulatory agencies and represents Amazon at appropriate levels with governmental agencies and throughout the company.
  • Ensure work performed by contractors, consultants, and employees is completed in accordance with regulatory requirements and Amazon standards.
  • Monitor environmental metrics to review trends to determine where improvements are needed.
  • Conduct thorough and accurate environmental inspections and audits for continuous improvement.
  • Prioritize and manage multiple, technically complex assignments, concurrently.
  • Build and manage collaborative relationships with various stakeholders to ensure risks are identified early and managed appropriately.
  • Compile and submit time critical reports to various governmental agencies.
  • Complete thorough and accurate environmental incident investigations and associated regulatory reports, and develop appropriate corrective actions.
  • Ensure site leadership and associates are trained and knowledgeable of their responsibilities under each policy.

A day in the life

The MSEM will complete environmental performance analysis, establish and monitor metrics, and guide the operations leadership teams in implementation of Amazon environmental standards. The MSEM will work with internal and external partners that include government entities, contractors, consultants, design, construction, operations and other key stakeholders.

About the team

The EAP organization protects Amazon businesses and supports the needs of our customers by proactively mitigating environmental regulatory risks and protecting the environment.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in the Environmental Sciences, Environmental Engineering, or related field
  • Experience developing and implementing environmental compliance programs including regulated waste, water, and air regulations in accordance with applicable laws
  • Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience engaging with regulatory agencies in permit applications or equivalent
  • Experience in environmental compliance and permitting, waste management, contractual, regulatory, and liability assessments, environmental permit evaluations and applications, EIAs and water discharge requirements
  • Knowledge of Brazilian state and federal environmental regulations

Overview

Há quase 80 anos, a WLM atua estrategicamente nos setores automotivo, agronegócio, energia e soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

Nosso foco principal é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus, peças genuínas e manutenção especializada.

Estamos presentes em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados pelas operações: Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac (AM e RR).

Dentro desse ecossistema de soluções, a Equipo Locadora é especialista em soluções personalizadas para empresas que precisam de transporte sem complicações, oferecendo tecnologia, gestão inteligente de frota e atendimento próximo aos clientes. Com o objetivo de oferecer transporte inteligente e eficiente para empresas de diferentes portes e segmentos, sempre com foco em qualidade, confiabilidade e inovação.

No agronegócio , pelas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do MT, Sul de MG e região de Campinas/SP), atuamos na criação, recria e engorda de bovinos e na produção de café, soja e milho, sempre com foco em sustentabilidade e preservação ambiental.

Em 2025, adquirimos 60% da CHP Brasil , referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética, ampliando nosso portfólio e reforçando nosso compromisso com inovação e sustentabilidade.

Como parte dessa estratégia, nasceu a EkoTruck , startup voltada à reciclagem de caminhões, peças alternativas e componentes remanufaturados, reduzindo o TCO dos clientes e fortalecendo a economia circular.

Com unidades estrategicamente localizadas, garantimos cobertura nacional, agilidade e excelência no atendimento. Nossa holding está no Rio de Janeiro e contamos com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

Como Auxiliar de Mecânico, você vai apoiar a equipe de manutenção em inspeções, manutenções preventivas e reparos básicos, contribuindo para que os veículos estejam sempre seguros, eficientes e prontos para rodar.

Fundada em 20 de agosto de 1972, a Unimed do Estado do Rio de Janeiro – Federação Estadual das Cooperativas Médicas (Unimed Ferj) atua há 52 anos como representante estatutária de todas as Unimeds do estado. Com uma governança corporativa voltada para a sustentabilidade e uma cultura organizacional focada em pessoas, a Unimed Ferj é uma referência no Sistema Unimed fluminense, que gera aproximadamente 16 mil empregos diretos e conta com uma ampla rede credenciada. Na função de Operadora de plano de saúde, a Unimed Ferj se dedica a oferecer um atendimento de excelência a mais de 470 mil clientes, por meio de uma ampla rede de médicos cooperados, unidades próprias e serviços credenciados.

Desde abril de 2024, a Unimed Ferj assumiu a gestão, o dimensionamento estrutural e o direcionamento assistencial do Hospital Unimed e dos Prontos Atendimentos Unimed na cidade do Rio de Janeiro. Nas unidades próprias, são mais de 2.400 profissionais comprometidos e dedicados a oferecer um cuidado humanizado e de excelência aos nossos pacientes.

Buscamos pessoas que valorizam as relações humanas e abraçam novas oportunidades. Na Rede Própria da Unimed Ferj, promovemos a diversidade, respeitamos diferentes ideias e perspectivas, e vivemos os princípios do cooperativismo, sempre com foco na excelência do cuidado.

Temos o propósito de que as entregas sejam acessíveis para todas as pessoas do Brasil. Esse é nosso desafio diário, por isso, buscamos inovação em tudo que fazemos.

Por aqui, valorizamos diferentes formas de pensar, pois sabemos que só assim podemos criar o futuro.

title: Corporate Communications Senior Manager
description:
Corporate Communications Senior Manager

Department: Communications

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Corporate Communications Senior Manager will lead strategic planning and delivery of communications and public relations strategies and activities for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, ensuring the tournament is powerfully positioned in line with FIFA’s overall strategic objectives and the FIFA Women’s Football Strategy.

This role is responsible to support the Head of Communications & Media Relations in the rollout and implementation of the Communications components of the tournament’s Marketing & Communications Strategy, with a strong focus on Brazil and South America. The position plays a central role in leading the development and implementation of proactive corporate communications that enhance FIFA’s reputation, raises awareness on the tournament, influences public perception, engages with internal and external stakeholders for higher impact and ensures consistency across proactive and reactive messaging at a global level.

Reporting jointly to the Head of Communications & Media Relations based in Brazil and to the Team Lead Corporate Communications in Switzerland, the Corporate Communications Senior Manager will collaborates with senior stakeholders, decision-makers, and leadership teams to translate corporate priorities and tournament objectives into engaging, credible narratives.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead and implement a corporate communications-first approach, delivering proactive, strategic messaging and storytelling across Brazil and South America in line with the Marketing & Communications Strategy.
  • Develops messaging for tournament milestones, events, initiatives, campaigns, announcements and key FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ functional areas.
  • Act as the central integrator for communications-related matters, coordinating internal and external stakeholders including FIFA27 functional teams, Host City communications teams, federal, state and municipal authorities, the CBF, and other key partners.
  • Develop and implement pre‑emptive communications plans to manage risk, address sensitive topics and engage targeted audiences.
  • Develop issues and crisis communications planning and execution within FIFA27 in close alignment with the FIFA Communications Division, supporting all relevant partners and activities in the lead‑up to and during the tournament.
  • Build close working relationships with other Marketing and Communications teams to ensure narrative unity and operational efficiency.
  • Partner with the Media Relations department to identify and amplify proactive stories that shape public understanding of FIFA’s initiatives.
  • Partner with digital, editorial, and campaign teams to deliver integrated storytelling across FIFA’s ecosystem,
  • Perform other duties directly related to the role, as required by FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ leadership or the FIFA Communications Division.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum 7 years experience in communications, media and public relations, with experience in similar leadership positions
  • Familiarity with the world of football. Passion for women’s football is a plus
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written) and Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Spanish language skills are an asset
  • Able and willing to travel up to 50% of the year
  • Able and willing to work non‑traditional hours including evenings and weekends as needed
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Founded in early 2002, viaPeople set out to redefine the human resources software industry by adopting a unique business model. Unlike competitors that offered one-size-fits-all solutions, we committed to developing best‑of‑breed products tailored to the distinct needs of our clients. Our approach combines expert‑driven design with exceptional flexibility to address even the most complex requirements, all while maintaining a steadfast focus on product excellence, relationship management, and superior service quality.

You will own lead ingestion, enrichment, and sourcing efforts while partnering closely with sales leadership to ensure pipeline health, data quality, and visibility into performance. This role is ideal for someone who is highly organized, data‑oriented, and motivated by building systems that enable consistent outbound success.

This is a foundational role on the growth team with clear exposure to sales strategy, tooling, and performance metrics.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Development & Lead Sourcing

Sales Operations & Data Integrity

  • Maintain clean, accurate, and enriched CRM data

Reporting & Dashboards

    • Lead volume and source

  • Provide regular reporting and insights to sales leadership

Cross‑Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Sales, Marketing, and Leadership to align on pipeline goals

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred (or equivalent experience)

  • Strong analytical and organizational skills with attention to detail
  • Experience working with CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar)

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Self-starter who thrives in a fast‑moving, early‑growth environment
  • Interest in B2B SaaS, HR technology, or sales operations is a plus

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary Range: Competitive Compensation Package
  • Bonus: Performance‑based bonus tied to pipeline and data quality metrics
  • PTO: Generous unlimited PTO and holiday schedule
  • Growth Opportunity: Direct exposure to sales strategy, tooling decisions, and leadership

Why This Role Matters

This role is critical to ensuring viaPeople’s sales team operates with clarity, consistency, and momentum. You’ll help power the front end of the revenue engine while providing the insights leadership needs to scale efficiently.

title: Ad Ops Onboarding Manager - Publishers (Remote)
description:
About MonetizeMore

MonetizeMore is a global leader in ad tech, seen by 300M+ people monthly. For 16 years, we’ve achieved double-digit growth by blending proprietary AI technology with manual optimization techniques to empower publishers. We are a culture-centric, location-independent organization that values Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen, and Collaboration.

MonetizeMore offers location and schedule freedom to every one of its team members. That means that you would have the lifestyle autonomy to choose to work from anywhere in the world, during the time of day you prefer. This new-age work lifestyle would enable you to engineer your ideal lifestyle. Say goodbye to endless commutes, stuffy business attire, and the arbitrary 9 to 5 work-day. Take your life back into your hands by joining the MonetizeMore team!

What You’ll Do

As part of our Publisher Centric Team , At M2, we focus and emphasize proactive Publisher Services. As the Onboarding Manager, your role is a critical "first impression" of our organization and our ability to support our publishing partners in reaching their goals.

You will spearhead the onboarding process for new publishers, ensuring they are equipped with the right tech, knowledge, and confidence to succeed. You are not just setting up accounts you are orchestrating a "White Glove" experience that reduces time-to-value and sets the stage for long-term retention. You also pay attention to improving our systems and processes along the way to continuously improve our service to publishers.

Responsibilities

  1. Project Management & Implementation
    • Lead the Lifecycle: Expertly manage the publisher journey from Sales endorsement to "Live" status. You are the project manager for the publisher’s first 30-90 days.
    • Technical Coordination: Collaborate with Account Executives and Solutions Engineers to troubleshoot setup concerns (Header Bidding, GAM, wrappers) and ensure optimal configuration.
    • Feature Activation: Ensure all applicable M2 Tech Features are activated at launch to maximize publisher revenue immediately (KPI: Uptake %).
  2. Client-Centric Communication & Education
    • Kick-off & Strategy: Conduct kick-off calls to understand the publisher's specific business goals and align our implementation plan to meet them.
    • Ambassadorship: Act as the primary champion for M2 tools and products. Provide comprehensive walkthroughs to ensure publishers are comfortable and proficient with our platform.
    • Responsive Support: Serve as the primary point of contact for all questions during installation, providing guidance that is both technical and empathetic.
  3. Performance Analysis & Handoff
    • Performance Reviews: Conduct thorough 7-day and 30-day post-live performance reviews. Use data to demonstrate value and identify early optimization wins.
    • Seamless Transition: Manage a structured handoff to the Ad Optimizer and Customer Success Manager, ensuring no momentum is lost after the initial 30-day period.

Day-today Activities

You are the external face of MonetizeMore for our newest partners. You thrive on variety and high-energy interaction—no two days (or publishers) are exactly alike.

  • External Engagement: You will constantly meet new partners, leading high-impact kickoff calls to align our tech with their specific business goals.
  • Project Command: You project manage the entire implementation lifecycle, coordinating between the publisher and our technical teams to ensure an optimal, revenue-ready setup and accelerated scale.
  • Performance Ownership: You don't just "set it and forget it." You conduct data-driven 7-day and 30-day etc. performance reviews to prove value immediately.
  • Seamless Handoff: Once the foundation is solid, you orchestrate a smooth transfer to the account management team ensuring the relationship momentum continues uninterrupted.

How this role fits into the organization

This is a cornerstone role that is pivotal to our company’s success.

  • Strategic Impact: Reporting to the Ad Ops Team Manager, you are the architect of the "First 30 Days." Since our publishers' growth is our growth, our long-term revenue goals effectively start on your desk.
  • The "Wow" Factor: You are responsible for delivering the "White Glove" experience. You set the trajectory for retention by uncovering publisher goals early and proving that MonetizeMore is a partner, not just a vendor.
  • Bridge Builder: You act as the vital link between Sales promises and long-term Operational success, ensuring that every new client enters our ecosystem with clarity, confidence, and a setup primed for revenue generation.

Who You Are

Must Haves

  • Experience: 1+ years of experience in Programmatic sell-side advertising, Customer Onboarding, or Ad Operations.
  • Technical Knowledge: Understanding of Google Ad Manager (GAM), AdSense, Header Bidding, and Google Analytics. Experience with WordPress and debugging ad calls is a strong plus.
  • Analytical Skills: Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and data presentation tools. You can spot trends in numbers quickly.
  • Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. You can command a room (virtually) and manage expectations clearly.
  • Project Management: Demonstrated ability to manage multiple implementations simultaneously without dropping the ball.

Nice to Have

  • Has worked with AdSense, Google Analytics, and GAM and has extensive knowledge of Google policies and other platforms
  • Understands coding and has a strong tech background
  • Has worked with WordPress and is knowledgeable when it comes to implementing ads and debugging ad calls
  • Bilingual - Portuguese and Spanish are an extra bonus

What We Offer

  • Competitive Salary : Our salary formula adjusts to your cost of living and experience.
  • Work remotely : Live and work wherever you like!
  • Flexible working hours : You have the autonomy to set your own schedule
  • Retreats : We meet in person for company get-togethers.
  • Career growth and learning opportunities

If you think you are a good fit to join our Ad Optimization , please apply on this side bar and give specific reasons what sets you apart. We hire individuals, not robots so don’t be afraid to show a little personality.

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion. Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.
